people.name: Barak
people.line: An Israelite commander who defeated Canaanite forces with Deborah.

translations.web: Barak said to her, “If you will go with me, then I will go; but if you will not go with me, I will not go.”
translations.bsb: Barak said to her, “If you will go with me, I will go; but if you will not go with me, I will not go.”
